pattern: 羽目になる（はめになる）
purpose: Describe being forced by events into an unwanted action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
I missed the train and ended up having to walk.
I lost my key and had to climb in through the window.
Errors were found, and we had to redo everything.
restrictions: The result is burdensome or regrettable.
mistake: Avoid for a straightforward welcome opportunity.
